# `> animated_assets`

This profile uses generated SVG assets to add motion directly to the GitHub README.

```text
assets/generated/

├── matrix.svg
│   └── Matrix-style text effects and green terminal visuals
│
├── terminal.svg
│   └── Terminal output and animated development logs
│
├── status.svg
│   └── Process states and animated progress indicators
│
├── activity.svg
│   └── GitHub development activity visualization
│
└── skyline.svg
    └── Animated project / developer skyline
```
